title: Overprint marker index: one multiply bar that cuts between rows
summary: A sortable project index with a single `aria-hidden` marker in an isolated stacking context, blended `multiply` between the rows' plates (z 1) and their words (z 3), so the plate under it is overprinted while the active row's words turn to the paper colour; it is moved by writing the row's own `offsetTop` and height, never transitioned, so every frame sits exactly on a row; it follows a mouse, keyboard focus (with a focus ring drawn on the text layer), and on touch screens the row crossing a reading line at 40 % of the viewport; sort buttons re-order the rows, announce the order in a status and step the rows back in by hard sets `.03 s` apart; a registered `blinkOnce` effect when the marker first appears; forced colours swap the marker for an outline; reduced motion keeps the cut and drops the blink and the stepped re-entry
variants: one marker cut between rows, pointer, keyboard and reading line (this, default)
a marker inside a step indicator or carousel nav: the same cut by index, with a blink on the press
with a cursor-following preview beside the marked row: hover-preview-list for the preview, this for the mark
